eventTypes.name: RFQ only
eventTypes.how: EventGroup with one TradeRequest rfx_mode=rfq (current_status=rfqing). Created via POST /trade/template_input with rfx_mode 'rfq' + event_group_id.

Commercial stages need trade_products

eventTypes.name: RFP (technical) only
eventTypes.how: One TradeRequest rfx_mode=rfp (or legacy rfi); current_status nil, auction_config nil; vendors answer TemplateResponses (forms), buyer evaluates.

rules.rule: rfi/rfp set current_status=nil and auction_config=nil
A live RFP-only event can get ONE extra RFQ stage via POST /trade/:id/add_new_stage_in_live_event (config is_add_new_stage_allowed)
'Add new Stage' button only shown when exactly one valid stage and it is rfp, event latest and not a fresh draft

eventTypes.name: RFP + RFQ
eventTypes.how: Two TradeRequests in one EventGroup: rfp (stage 1) then rfq (stage 2). stage_no recomputed at publish from STANDARD_STAGES_SEQUENCE.

rules.rule: RFP bidding end time must not exceed RFQ bidding end time (checked at EG publish and on stage time edits)
Same check on stage create/extend: rfp end > rfq end or rfq end < rfp end refused (skipped for draft trade / MCP / draft new-stage rfp)
Vendor not invited to RFP-stage and not directly invited to RFQ, or invited to RFP but did not respond, cannot bid on RFQ
Cannot add another stage to an event that already has rfp+rfq

eventTypes.name: RFQ -> Auction

rules.rule: Only an active RFQ can be moved

Source already auctioning refused
line_item_based RFQ cannot become lot_based multi-product auction

auctionTypes.name: Rank auction

auctionTypes.name: Price (best price) auction
auctionTypes.how: auction_config=1. Best price indicator shown for price/rank_and_price auctions

auctionTypes.name: Traffic light

auctionTypes.name: Knockout
auctionTypes.how: auction_config=4; misc.auction_strategy_config {strategy, bulk_price(start), time_difference(>=30s else 248), price_difference (negated for sell), is_auction_on_base_price}; missing fields 237; round longer than auction 238; runs as TradeRound rows (auction_strategy knockout); TradeRoundSchedulerWorker ends auction when no participant accepts a round

auctionTypes.name: Dutch
auctionTypes.how: auction_config=5; auction_strategy_config {bulk_price(start), end_price, time_difference, price_difference(tick), is_auction_on_base_price, closing_mode single/multiple, remaining_quantity}; sell: start>=end (241), buy: start<=end (242), tick <= range (243); is_order_allowed_to_close_in_extra_closing_time_only forced false

draftAndVersioning.fact: Draft EG stages hidden from everyone except owner/super admin/procol employee
Saving a draft EG (status draft) voids stages in delete_draft_stage_ids or not in draft_trade_request_ids, deleting their forms/TPs
Draft line-item delete -> EGLI in_active + TPs void; live delete -> EGLI deleted + forms deleted + stage closed if no active EGLIs

Withdrawing a DRAFT EG turns its draft stages 'cancelled', which EventGroup.trade_requests excludes -> unrecoverable via API (no un-cancel path found); clone refuses draft EG and would copy no cancelled stages
Clone: only active/withdrawn, not PR-based, not planner; copies active line items + rfi/rfp/rfq stages (not in_active, not lot stages, never auctions) into a new DRAFT EG
Versioning: POST /item_versions (EventGroup only) -> ItemVersion draft + replica EG in draft with draft EGLIs, RFP + latest commercial stage replicated
latest? = no non-in_active ItemVersion where item_id=self; non-latest versions refused (101) on update, move_to_auction, bids, proposals

can_create_new_version? (config is_event_versioning_enabled, not draft/withdrawn, latest, no active/requested/selected proposal, no lot split, auction needs allow_versioning_post_auction) is only a UI flag; the endpoint authorizes create_version? = update? + create_record
Publishing an amendment draft requires amendment_remarks (raises if blank)
On new version draft->active, previous version's stages are force-ended and PR mappings moved
ItemVersion status follows new item: active/withdrawn -> active, else in_active; ref_id becomes '<base>.<version_order>'

other.fact: Stage timing is schedule-driven: bid_start_time/bid_end_time read from trade_schedules by current_status; closed_at = last active schedule end (incl. evaluation/extra closing)
display_status: active+running='Open', active+not running='Expired', closed='Closed', in_active='Withdrawn'

Jobs scheduled on create: AutoAwardWorker at bid_end+3s (if auto-award), EventGroupUpdateWorker at start/end/closed_at, DeleteDraftBidsWorker at bid_end, MarkEventClosedWorker at closed_at, Savings workers at closed_at+5s
GAP (unverified live): EG update has no server-side from->to status guard; PATCH status 'draft' or status 'active'+config on a non-draft EG reaches execute() which sets @event_group.status
Vendor bid create does not check trade.status directly - relies on is_running (withdrawal ends schedules via mark_end_time_of_current_trade_schedule)
EG 'ended' scope = no stage in active/closed/scheduled with closed_at >= now
Recurring (scheduled) events are EventGroups with is_scheduled_template=true + ScheduledJob; list endpoint GET /event_groups/scheduled needs feature flag (904)
FE stage list PROJECT_STAGES: rfp 'Technical Stage', rfq 'RFQ', auction 'Auction'
